nicole-mgr: Quick Q — proposing a comp-only adjustment for Priya (no level change). It's ~12% and we'd like to backdate to 2029-05-01. What funding options work and any backpay limits?

people-ops: Comp-only ok for performance retention. Funding options: team discretionary, spot bonus pool, or reallocated hiring budget. If >10% we usually require Finance sign-off on source. Backpay policy: up to 90 days retro is auto-considered; >90 days needs exec sponsor.

jamal-comp: Also include internal parity note — list 2 peers and band percentiles. For comp-only, we prefer band-target (e.g., midpoint +10%) not raw $$. 

rit a-fin: If you choose hiring budget reallocation, we'll need updated headcount forecast and GL code changes. For backdating, payroll needs completed packet 5 business days before run. Off-cycle payroll for backpay has a processing fee and may delay by one pay cycle.

nicole-mgr: Thanks — any documentation examples for the comp rationale?

people-ops: One-paragraph rationale + 3 bullets of sustained impact + requested band percentile + funding_source field. Paste bullets in the form or attach links.

payroll-bot: payroll_deadline=1905002400 UTC for next off-cycle run. Submit before that to be eligible for May retro. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/payroll

nicole-mgr: Filing now. Will mark funding_source=hiring_realloc and include parity notes. Appreciate the quick answers.
